1: MWM gas engines and generator sets cover an electrical output range from 400 to 4,500 kW.
MWM provides gas engines and power generators for different gas types used in various applications such as combined generation of heat and power.
MWM looks back on more than 150 years of experience in the field of decentralized energy supply.
